title: Suspicion Means Death
description: Every suspicious word, hesitation, contradiction, or out-of-role action increases the vampire's suspicion. At maximum suspicion, the player dies.

fragments.prompt: The scene uses a Suspicion meter from 0 to 5. It starts at 1. Suspicion increases when the player contradicts their role, gives implausible explanations, hesitates at dangerous moments, invents abilities, or makes Valtherion suspect poison or betrayal. At 5 Suspicion, Valtherion attacks and the scene is lost.
fragments.heavenRule: Kami-sama declares: Suspicion is gravity. Every contradiction falls somewhere.
fragments.contentBoundary: Do not make suspicion arbitrary. Increase it when the player creates genuine risk, breaks role, lies poorly, or acts suspiciously. Reward clever cooking, careful phrasing, and believable improvisation.

generationHints.preferredUse: Use for scenes where words and small choices matter.
generationHints.avoidUse: Avoid with pure combat or purely cozy scenes.
